Name: Improved Coffee Bean
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[size=3]This mod makes mass harvesting of coffee beans from the middle of the game a little easier.


The performance of the improved coffee beans themselves (season when they can be planted, number of days until harvest) is the same as the conventional ones.

Harvesting with a sickle yields normal coffee bean.

Improved Coffee Bean Maker (Seed Maker) will send you recipes by email when you achieve the requirements.

Can create Improved Coffee Bean from 15 coffee beans.[/size]

[spoiler]
[b][color=#dd7e6b][size=6]Improved Coffee Bean Maker[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]"Gus" Friendship Level 3.[/size]
[*][size=3]"Farming" Skill Level 8.[/size]
[*][size=3]One or more Coffee Bean were shipped.[/size]
[*][size=3]At least 5 Keg are created.[/size]
[*][size=3]At least 3 Triple Shot Espresso have been created.[/size]
[/list]
[/spoiler]

English and Japanese are supported.
